name: basic
description: Built into pcb and always on: the board is complete and self-consistent. Process limits come from a fab rule set (`pcb drc add`).

rules.name: outline-exists
rules.description: A board needs an outline before anything can be checked against it.

rules.name: parts-placed
rules.description: Every non-virtual part has a placement.

rules.name: copper-inside-outline
rules.description: Pads, traces, vias and pours lie within the outline.

rules.name: copper-clearance
rules.description: Copper of different nets keeps the project's `clearance` rule.

rules.name: copper-to-edge
rules.description: Copper keeps the project's `edge_clearance` from the board edge.

rules.name: pins-connected
rules.description: A pin on no net is usually a forgotten connection (NC pins can be waived).

rules.name: nets-routed
rules.description: Every net is one island of copper.

rules.name: dangling-trace
rules.description: Both ends of a trace land on copper of its net.

rules.name: floating-copper
rules.description: Every piece of a pour reaches a pad of its net (pieces that do not are removed from output, but usually mean the fill is not doing what you think).
